name: Talking head with bold captions
feel: Close, quick and direct: one person speaking to camera, every pause cut out, big words on screen so it works with the sound off.
rules: Cut every breath and filler word; leave a few frames after the last syllable.
Punch in on the face every third cut, and on the line that matters most.
Highlight the one word in each card that carries the meaning.
The first spoken line is the hook; no logo or greeting before it.
